items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: I went to Germany, (inaudible) in 1957 to take over his band. The piece was written for that band.

ctx.x: It's a typical twelve tone piece of the period. It uses Kenton as the bass and the strange thing is I went to Germany, (inaudible) in 1957 to take over his band. The piece was written for that band. They did it before I got there. It was a Kenton type band.

None of those things have ever come off. I think it's a piece of craftsmanship, the piece is very good. I don't think of it as an artistic success, and none of those things, to me, ever are. I think they are fatuous, in some cases, and begging the question in others.
